hypotheses.name: STRING triad-closure weighted filtration
hypotheses.method: Seed42 run across immune/lung/external_lung with source/target-disjoint splits and layers {7,11}; compared H93 backbone vs STRING triad-closure weighted filtration with nulls: STRING-weight shuffle, triad node permutation, label permutation.
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this exact N538 formulation; only revisit with a materially changed filtration objective.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Fail-fast gate triggered: positive mean null-gap in 0/6 domain-splits.
